question: Which region has the highest average perceptions of corruption?
query: SELECT "regional_indicator" FROM world_happiness_report GROUP BY "regional_indicator" ORDER BY AVG("perceptions_of_corruption") DESC LIMIT 50;
raw_results:
| regional_indicator |
| --- |
| Central and Eastern Europe |
| South Asia |
| Sub-Saharan Africa |
| Latin America and Caribbean |
| Commonwealth of Independent States |
| Middle East and North Africa |
| None |
| Southeast Asia |
| East Asia |
| Western Europe |
| North America and ANZ |
answer: Based on the provided data, **Central and Eastern Europe** has the highest average perceptions of corruption.
